about: Facts that several documents repeat. Each entry names the source that decides the fact and every place that states it. tests/test_doc_facts.py fails when a source no longer contains its text, or a statement is missing, and lists the places to revisit. Matching ignores line breaks and runs of spaces. docs/src/README.md, 'Repeated facts', explains when to add an entry.

facts.fact: YTP/1 uses one fixed suite: Ed25519 and ML-DSA-87 identities, X25519 and ML-KEM-1024 key establishment, HKDF-SHA256 and AES-256-GCM. ML-KEM-1024 and ML-DSA-87 are NIST security category 5, so the post-quantum claims change with the parameter sets.
